ResetHotlineNumber.description_en: Invoke the ResetHotlineNumber API to reset the inbound (IVR flow) and outbound (effective scope) configuration information of a hotline number
ResetHotlineNumber.description_zh: 调用ResetHotlineNumber接口重置热线号码的呼入（IVR流程）、呼出（生效范围）配置信息

RobotCall.description_en: Initiate an outbound call using the Intelligent Contact Robot
RobotCall.description_zh: 发起智能联络机器人呼出

SendCcoSmartCall.description_en: Initiate an Intelligent Speech Interaction call based on the callee's caller ID, callee number, and intelligent outbound call audio file
SendCcoSmartCall.description_zh: 根据被叫显号、被叫号码、智能外呼放音文件发起智能语音交互通话

SendCcoSmartCallOperate.description_en: Initiates a specified action during an Intelligent Outbound Call, applicable only to scenarios such as parallel transfer to a human agent or allowing a human agent to listen in on the man-machine dialogue
SendCcoSmartCallOperate.description_zh: 在智能外呼通话中，发起指定动作，仅用于并行转人工，人工坐席可旁听人机对话等场景

SendHotlineHeartBeat.description_en: Send a hotline heartbeat request based on the instance ID, agent account name, and heartbeat signature
SendHotlineHeartBeat.description_zh: 根据实例ID、坐席账号名称、心跳签名发送热线心跳请求

StartAiOutboundTask.description_en: Start an outbound calling job by instance ID and job ID
StartAiOutboundTask.description_zh: 根据实例ID、任务ID启动外呼任务

StartCall.description_en: Initiate an outbound call based on the instance ID, agent account name, hotline outbound caller number, and callee number
StartCall.description_zh: 根据实例ID、坐席账号名称、热线外呼主叫号码、被叫号码发起外呼

StartCallV2.description_en: Invoke StartCallV2 to initiate an outbound call V2

StartChatWork.description_en: Invoke StartChatWork to switch an online agent to the working status
StartChatWork.description_zh: 调用StartChatWork设置在线坐席为上班状态

StartHotlineService.description_en: Sign in a hotline agent by instance ID and agent account name to start the hotline service.
StartHotlineService.description_zh: 根据实例ID、坐席账号名称进行热线坐席签入，开始热线服务

StartMicroOutbound.description_en: Invoke the StartMicroOutbound API to initiate an outbound call request
StartMicroOutbound.description_zh: 调用StartMicroOutbound接口发起外呼请求

StartTask.description_en: Start a successfully created Intelligent Contact Robot calling job
StartTask.description_zh: 启动已创建成功的智能联络机器人呼叫任务

StopAiOutboundTask.description_en: Pause an outbound calling job by instance ID and job ID
StopAiOutboundTask.description_zh: 根据实例ID、任务ID暂停外呼任务

StopTask.description_en: Pause an Intelligent Contact Robot calling job that has been successfully started
StopTask.description_zh: 暂停已成功启动的智能联络机器人呼叫任务

SuspendHotlineService.description_en: Pause hotline service when an agent takes a short break
SuspendHotlineService.description_zh: 在热线坐席小休时，暂停热线服务

TerminateAiOutboundTask.description_en: Terminate an outbound call job by instance ID and job ID
TerminateAiOutboundTask.description_zh: 根据实例ID、任务ID终止外呼任务

TransferCallToSkillGroup.description_en: Invoke the TransferCallToSkillGroup API to execute a single-step or two-step transfer to a skill group
TransferCallToSkillGroup.description_zh: 调用TransferCallToSkillGroup接口执行单/双步转交到技能组

UpdateAgent.description_en: Modify agent information in the Cloud Customer Service System based on the instance ID and agent account name. You can modify the agent's display name and the skill groups to which the agent belongs
UpdateAgent.description_zh: 根据实例ID、坐席账号名称修改悉犀客服工作台坐席信息。支持修改坐席对外显示名称、坐席所属技能组

UpdateAiCallTask.description_en: Updates the configuration of a voice call task

UpdateAiOutboundTask.description_en: Update an outbound call job by instance ID and job ID
UpdateAiOutboundTask.description_zh: 根据实例ID、任务ID更新外呼任务

UpdateDepartment.description_en: Update the department name based on the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS) instance ID and department ID
UpdateDepartment.description_zh: 根据AICCS实例ID、部门ID更新部门名称

UpdateOuterAccount.description_en: Invoke UpdateOuterAccount to update an external account based on the external account ID
UpdateOuterAccount.description_zh: 调用UpdateOuterAccount根据外部账号ID更新外部账号

UpdateSkillGroup.description_en: Update the skill group information in the Cloud Customer Service System based on the AICCS instance ID and skill group ID. This API supports updating the skill group description and display name
UpdateSkillGroup.description_zh: 根据AICCS实例ID、技能组ID更新悉犀客服工作台技能组信息。支持更新技能组描述、技能组对外显示名称
